dimension_description: Flow rate measures how much volume passes a boundary per unit time. This scale is useful for comparing microfluidics, medical drips, household plumbing, industrial systems, and the largest geophysical currents and rivers. Flow depends strongly on context, so representative operating conditions are part of the meaning.
